meta.stops_source: CDOT Statewide Transit Points (primary); agency GTFS feeds via the Mobility Database catalog; OpenStreetMap (unconfirmed)
meta.method: Each counted stop is buffered by 2 miles (straight-line, UTM zone 13N) and the buffers are merged into one shape, simplified by 25 m. Counted stops are confirmed (CDOT or an agency schedule feed), public and fixed-route: private airport/hotel shuttles, on-demand (GTFS-Flex) stops and OpenStreetMap-only stops are left out (scripts/lib/transit_stops.py).

agencies: San Miguel Authority for Regional Transportation
